brief: Small frame implement shed about 20 ft by 30 ft, faded and peeling barn-red vertical boards, a low gable roof of galvanized corrugated steel. The long side is half open as a wide wagon bay with a leaning prop post, the rest closed with a hinged plank door and a slatted opening. Tall dry bluestem grows up to the walls, white pipe corral panels and a stone wall beside it. (Open-bay implement shed; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
